name: Phoenix Price Labels for WooCommerce
author: phoenixwp

sections.description:
PhoenixWP Price Labels helps omnichannel shops print shelf prices from WooCommerce without cloud printing or per-label fees. Retail-first layouts include sale/regular pricing and German unit price (PAngV) text when your compliance plugin provides it.

Features

  • Offline PDF download — no external print service
  • Avery label sheets: L7159, L7160, L7163
  • Badgemaker insert sheets: 1451 and 1453 layouts
  • Plain-paper strips: 30 mm and 39 mm height
  • Product overview sheet (A4 catalog for checkout staff)
  • Fields: name, variation, gross price, sale/regular, unit price, SKU, EAN as text
  • Product picker and manual product IDs
  • Unlimited labels per run
  • HPOS compatible
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/phoenix-price-labels-for-woocommerce/ or install from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Go to PhoenixWP Price Labels, select products, choose a sheet preset, and download the PDF.
sections.faq:
Does this print directly to a label printer?

The plugin outputs PDF files for office printers (A4/Letter). Open the PDF and print from your system.

Where does unit price (Grundpreis) come from?

The plugin reads unit price data from WooCommerce and common German compliance plugins (German Market, Germanized, PAngV meta). Configure fallback text under Price Labels → Unit price settings if needed.

Can I use this without an internet connection after install?

Yes. PDF generation runs on your server. No cloud API is required.

Documentation and support: https://phoenixwp.com/support/
